name: AR_INTEREST_LINES_ALL
description: The AR_INTEREST_LINES_ALL table contains line level late charge document information.

columns.name: INTEREST_LINE_ID
columns.description: Interest line identifier. It is used as a primary key.

columns.name: INTEREST_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ra_interest_headers_all.interest_invoice_id

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: OUTSTANDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Outstanding Amount, overdue late payment amount

columns.name: DAYS_OVERDUE_LATE
columns.description: Number of days the payment is overdue or late.

columns.name: DAYS_OF_INTEREST
columns.description: Number of days for which interest is charged.

columns.name: INTEREST_CHARGED
columns.description: Amount of interest charged against an overdue transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Payment date used when late charges are calculated for late payments.

columns.name: FINANCE_CHARGE_CHARGED
columns.description: The adjustments of type FINCHRG this is deducted from the overdue amount of invoice to compute the simple interest for invoices.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL
columns.description: The original amount due for the transaction installment which is selected for late charge calculation.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING
columns.description: The remaining due amount for the transaction installment which is selected for late charge calculation.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRX_ID
columns.description: Link between a late charge interest line and its original transaction. RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID, AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL.CASH_RECEIPT_ID.

columns.name: LAST_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the late charge was last calculated for the transaction installment.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Payment schedule due date/Balance ford bill date

columns.name: ACTUAL_DATE_CLOSED
columns.description: Actual date closed of payment schedule

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest rate applied.

columns.name: RATE_START_DATE
columns.description: Rate effectivity start date

columns.name: RATE_END_DATE
columns.description: Rate effectivity end date

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DAYS_FROM
columns.description: From days of aging bucket line

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DAYS_TO
columns.description: To day of aging bucket line

columns.name: PROCESS_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message text

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Status code to indicate Success or Error

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRX_CLASS
columns.description: Interest on INV, DM (debits), CM, Receipt (credits)

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Lookup type : AR_CHARGE_LINE_TYPE

columns.name: DAILY_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Daily interest charged/interest amount charged

columns.name: RECEIVABLES_TRX_ID
columns.description: Interest line or penalty receivables transaction identifier used only for adjustments.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.
